<TITLE>EX-14.1</TITLE>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 14.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>S<SMALL>ILVER</SMALL> P<SMALL>OINT</SMALL> P<SMALL>RIVATE</SMALL> C<SMALL>REDIT</SMALL> F<SMALL>UND</SMALL> </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>S<SMALL>ILVER</SMALL> P<SMALL>OINT</SMALL> S<SMALL>PECIALTY</SMALL> L<SMALL>ENDING</SMALL> F<SMALL>UND</SMALL>&nbsp;&amp; </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>S<SMALL>ILVER</SMALL> P<SMALL>OINT</SMALL> C<SMALL>APITAL</SMALL>, L.P. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>JOINT CODE OF ETHICS </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>I.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Introduction </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Silver Point Capital, L.P. and certain of its affiliates (&#8220;<U>Silver Point</U>&#8221; or the &#8220;<U>Firm</U>&#8221;) serve as
investment advisers to private funds, Silver Point Specialty Lending Fund (&#8220;<U>SPSL</U>&#8221;) and Silver Point Private Credit Fund (&#8220;<U>SPPC</U>&#8221; and SPSL each, a &#8220;<U>BDC</U>&#8221; and, together, the
&#8220;<U>BDCs</U>&#8221;) (the private funds and the BDCs, each, a &#8220;Fund&#8221; and, collectively, the &#8220;<U>Funds</U>&#8221;) and as a result stand in a position of trust and confidence with respect to the Funds. Accordingly, we have a
duty to act in the best interests of the Funds. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Each Employee (as defined below) of Silver Point is required to conduct his/her business
with the highest legal and ethical standards, and in accordance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations. In order to comply with these requirements and protect the Firm&#8217;s reputation for integrity, the Firm has adopted this Code of
Ethics (the &#8220;<U>Code</U>&#8221;). This Code has been adopted in accordance with Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1(c)</FONT> under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (the &#8220;<U>1940 Act</U>&#8221;) and Rule <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">204A-1(a)</FONT> under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (the &#8220;<U>Advisers Act</U>&#8221;). This Code is also intended to provide the BDCs and the Firm (the &#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT>
Organizations</U>&#8221;) with regulations and procedures designed to comply with the 1940 Act and the Advisers Act, and in particular, Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1(b)</FONT> under the 1940 Act, which generally proscribes fraudulent
or manipulative practices with respect to an investment company by persons associated with such investment company. Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1(b)</FONT> states (defined terms used below in paragraph (a)&nbsp;of this section 1 have
the meaning given to such terms in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1(a)):</FONT> </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">It is unlawful for any affiliated person of or principal underwriter for a Fund, or any affiliated person of an
investment adviser of or principal underwriter for a Fund, in connection with the purchase or sale, directly or indirectly, by the person of a security held or to be acquired by the Fund: </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">1.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">To employ any device, scheme or artifice to defraud the Fund; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">2.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">To make any untrue statement of a material fact to the Fund or omit to state a material fact necessary in order
to make the statements made to the Fund, in light of the circumstances under which they are made, not misleading; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">3.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">To engage in any act, practice or course of business that operates or would operate as a fraud or deceit upon
the Fund; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">4.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">To engage in any manipulative practice with respect to the Fund. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Code also proscribes securities transactions involving insider trading (as described below) as well as possible conflicts of interest. The
Code supplements and should be read in conjunction with the Silver Point BDC Compliance Manual, as well as Silver Point&#8217;s Compliance Manual, Information Barrier Policy, Employee Handbook and other Firm policies or procedures.<SUP
STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1</SUP> </P><DIV STYLE="line-height:8.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000;width:11%">&nbsp;</DIV>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">1.</SUP></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Defined terms used but not defined in this Code shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Firm&#8217;s
Manual. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">1 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Code codifies the following general principles which all Employees are expected to
uphold: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">A.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">We must act in the best interests of the Funds. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">B.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">We must comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations of the jurisdictions in which the Firm or the
Funds operate or invest. It is the personal responsibility of each Employee to adhere to the standards and restrictions imposed by those laws, rules and regulations. These laws include, among others, relevant sections of the Securities Act of 1933,
as amended, the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, as amended, and any relevant rules and regulations adopted by the Securities and Exchange Commission
(the &#8220;<U>SEC</U>&#8221;) under any of those statutes. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">C.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Employees must not take any inappropriate advantage of their positions at the Firm. Service to the Firm should
never be subordinated to personal gain or advantage. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">D.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">All personal securities transactions must be conducted in a manner consistent with the Code and must avoid any
actual or potential conflicts of interest, or any abuse of an Employee&#8217;s position of trust and responsibility. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">E.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Information concerning the identity of securities and the financial circumstances of the Funds and their
investors must be kept confidential. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firm believes that these general principles not only help us fulfill our
fiduciary obligations, but also protect the Firm&#8217;s reputation and instill in our Employees the Firm&#8217;s commitment to honesty, integrity and professionalism. All Employees should understand that these general principles apply to all
conduct, whether or not the conduct is also covered by more specific standards or procedures set forth below. Access Persons (as defined below) are expected to uphold these same general principles with respect to the BDCs. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Any violation of the Code by any Access Person, Employee or members of an Employee&#8217;s Family (as defined below) may result in dismissal,
suspension with or without pay, or other disciplinary sanctions against the Access Person or Employee, regardless of whether or not the violation of the Code also constitutes a violation of law. In situations where a violation of the Code might also
constitute a violation of applicable law &#8211; such as trading while in possession of, or tipping on the basis of, Material <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Public</FONT> Information (as defined below) &#8211; penalties might include civil or
criminal liability, including fines, imprisonment, disgorgement of profits realized or losses avoided, and other sanctions. All Employees and Access Persons should be aware that the Firm may initiate or cooperate in proceedings resulting in such
liability. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Finally, the Code does not attempt to identify all possible conflicts of interests and literal compliance with each of the
specific procedures will not shield an Employee or Access Person from liability for personal trading or other conduct that violates our duty to act in the best interest of the Funds. Accordingly, the policies and procedures contained in the Code
will be interpreted broadly to prevent any situation which could impugn our reputation for professionalism and integrity. It is the duty of all Employees and Access Persons to follow both the specific requirements and the spirit of the Code. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>II.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Persons and Accounts Covered by the Code </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">A.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><U>Employees, Access Persons and Advisory Persons</U> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Code applies to all of the Firm&#8217;s employees, which for purposes of the Code includes all of our directors, officers, partners,
employees, and any other affiliated persons designated by the Legal and Compliance Department (which may include temporary employees, consultants, independent contractors and certain other persons) (each, an &#8220;<U>Employee</U>&#8221; or
&#8220;<U>you</U>&#8221; and, collectively, the &#8220;<U>Employees</U>&#8221; or &#8220;<U>we</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">With respect to the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organizations, many of the prohibitions of the Code apply to Access Persons. &#8220;<U>Access Person</U>&#8221; means any Advisory Person (as defined below) of a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT>
Organization. All of the Firm&#8217;s directors, officers, and general partners are presumed to be Access Persons of the BDCs. All of each BDC&#8217;s trustees, officers, and general partners are presumed to be Access Persons of the BDC. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">An &#8220;Advisory Person&#8221; of a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organization means: (i)&nbsp;any trustee, officer, general
partner or employee of a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organization (or of any company in a &#8220;<U>control</U>&#8221; (as defined in Section&nbsp;2(a)(9) of the 1940 Act) relationship to a
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organization) who, in connection with his or her regular functions or duties, makes, participates in, or obtains information regarding, the purchase or sale of Covered Securities (as defined below) by
the BDCs, or whose functions relate to the making of any recommendations with respect to such purchases or sales; and (ii)&nbsp;any natural person in a control relationship to a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organization who obtains
information concerning recommendations made to the BDCs with regard to the purchase or sale of Covered Securities by the BDCs. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Because the
Code applies to all Employees, its coverage also extends to all Access Persons of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organizations. Access Persons of <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organizations who are not Employees
consist solely of each BDC&#8217;s trustees who are not &#8220;interested persons&#8221; (as defined in Section&nbsp;2(a)(19) of the 1940 Act) of the BDCs (the &#8220;<U>Independent Trustees</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">B.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><U>Personal Securities Accounts and Covered Securities</U> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The requirements and restrictions contained in the Code apply to all Covered Securities (as defined below) in any Personal Securities Account
(as defined below). All Employees are required to promptly notify the Compliance Department of any change to the information previously provided to the Compliance Department with respect to their Personal Securities Accounts and/or any holdings of
Covered Securities. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">1.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><I>Personal Securities Accounts </I> </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The term &#8220;Personal Securities Account&#8221; means any securities account in which an Employee has any direct or indirect
&#8220;beneficial ownership&#8221;, as defined under Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">16a-1(a)(2)</FONT> of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or any securities account over which the Employee exercises investment discretion.
Securities accounts that do not permit trading in either Exchange Traded Funds (&#8220;ETFs&#8221;), Covered Securities (as defined below), or digital currencies (cryptocurrencies) are excluded from the definition of Personal Securities Account.
This policy includes the following types of accounts (including cash accounts, margin accounts, IRAs and 401(k)s, employee stock purchase plans, investment partnerships and hedge funds) through which securities may be traded (including those opened
prior to employment with the Firm) and cryptocurrency IRAs, wallets and exchanges (e.g. Coinbase): </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Accounts in the Employee&#8217;s name; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">b)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Accounts in the name of the Employee&#8217;s spouse or significant other living in the same residence;
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">c)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Accounts in the name of minor children, relatives or other individuals living with the Employee for whose
support the Employee is wholly or partially responsible (together with the Employee&#8217;s spouse, the Employee&#8217;s &#8220;<U>Family</U>&#8221;); </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">d)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Accounts in which the Employee, the Employee&#8217;s significant other living in the same residence, or a
member of the Employee&#8217;s Family has a beneficial interest, including Managed Accounts (as defined below) and accounts held in the name of a nominee or custodian (but excluding trusts for which the Employee, the Employee&#8217;s significant
other living in the same residence, or a member of the Employee&#8217;s Family has no investment discretion, which would not constitute Personal Securities Accounts); </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="13%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">e)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">Accounts with respect to which the Employee, the Employee&#8217;s significant other living in the same
residence, or a member of the Employee&#8217;s Family directly or indirectly controls or participates in, or has the right to control or to participate in, investment decisions (such as any trust or custodial accounts for which an Employee, the
Employee&#8217;s significant other living in the same residence, or any member of an Employee&#8217;s Family acts as trustee or otherwise exercises influence or control). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Any Employee seeking to establish a new Personal Securities Account must open such account with a brokerage included on the approved brokerage
list maintained by the Firm&#8217;s Compliance Department, unless approval is granted by the Chief Compliance Officer, or his designee, to open an account with another brokerage. Unless an exception is approved by Compliance, all new employees with
an account maintained by a brokerage firm not on the approved brokerage list, must transfer the holdings held in the account to one of the brokerage firms listed below and promptly close the account. </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
