<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">F.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A record of any decision to approve trading in Covered Securities; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">G.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A record of any material violation of the Code and any action taken in response to such a violation.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firm may, upon request, allow investors in the Funds to review the Code at the Firm&#8217;s offices. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Chief Compliance Officer of each <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organization shall, to the extent not otherwise covered
above, maintain and cause to be maintained in an easily accessible place at the principal place of business of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> Organization the following records and must make these records available to the
Securities and Exchange Commission at any time and from time to time for reasonable periodic, special or other examinations: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">A.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A copy of all codes of ethics adopted by the BDCs or the Firm and its affiliates, as the case may be, pursuant
to Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> that have been in effect at any time during the past five (5)&nbsp;years; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>

least five (5)&nbsp;years after the end of the fiscal year in which the violation occurs; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">A copy of each report made by an Employee or Access Person for at least two (2)&nbsp;years after the end of the
fiscal year in which the report is made, and for an additional three (3)&nbsp;years in a place that need not be easily accessible; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

the end of the fiscal year of the BDC in which such report is made or issued and for an additional three (3)&nbsp;years in a place that need not be easily accessible; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>

pursuant to Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> and the Code, or who are or were responsible for reviewing such reports; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

year in which it is made, and for an additional three (3)&nbsp;years in a place that need not be easily accessible; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

Personnel<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">8</SUP> of securities in an initial public offering or Private Placement for at least five (5)&nbsp;years after the end of the fiscal year in which the approval is granted.
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">With respect to the BDCs, the administration of the Code shall be the responsibility of the Chief Compliance Officer,
whose duties shall be as follows: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

their job function and title as well as any reporting obligation that Employee or Access Person may have in connection with their role at the BDCs, the Firm, or any other business, including a notation of any positions in public or private companies
held by Employees and Access Persons, and informing all Employees and Access Persons of their reporting obligations hereunder; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Employees and Access Persons initially upon hire and annually thereafter; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

effected by the BDCs; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

this Code that may appear consistent with the objectives of Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> and this Code; </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

effectiveness of the Code and on any issues arising under the Code since the last such report. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>XI.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Sanctions </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Any violation of any provision of the Code may result in disciplinary action. The Compliance Department will determine an appropriate sanction
for any violation with respect to a Fund other than the BDCs. Disciplinary action may include, among other sanctions, a letter of reprimand, disgorgement, suspension, demotion or termination of employment.
</P><DIV STYLE="line-height:8.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #000000;width:11%">&nbsp;</DIV>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">8</SUP>&nbsp;</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">&#8220;Investment Personnel&#8221; means portfolio managers or other employees of the Firm who participate in
making investment recommendations to the BDCs, as well as persons in a control relationship to the BDCs who obtain information about investment recommendations. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">17 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Any violation of the Code with respect to a BDC shall be subject to the imposition of such
sanctions as may be deemed appropriate under the circumstances to achieve the purposes of Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17j-1</FONT> and the Code. The sanctions to be imposed shall be determined by the BDC&#8217;s board of trustees,
including a majority of the Independent Trustees, provided, however, that with respect to violations by persons who are directors, managers, partners, officers or employees of the Firm (or of a company that controls the Firm), the sanctions to be
imposed shall be determined by the Firm (or the controlling person thereof). Sanctions may include, but are not limited to, suspension or termination of employment, a letter of censure and/or restitution of an amount equal to the difference between
the price paid or received by the BDC and the more advantageous price paid or received by the offending person. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><B>XII.</B></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left"><B>Acknowledgement of Receipt and Compliance </B></P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Firm will make available to each Employee and Access Person a copy of the Code and any amendments hereto. Any questions regarding any
provision of the Code or its application should be directed to the Compliance Department. Each Employee and Access Person must provide the Firm with an acknowledgement evidencing the fact that such Employee or Access Person has received, reviewed,
and understands the Code: (i)&nbsp;upon the date of commencement of employment, and (ii)&nbsp;as required by the Compliance Department thereafter. The acknowledgement will be provided by the Compliance Department through the Firm&#8217;s Compliance
Science electronic platform. </P>
